card.name: Spread of infection to other people
card.fires_on: Words about passing infection on or contact with others, such as 'infection' after 'risk of' or 'transmission of', and 'with' or 'others' after close contact. Seen mostly in live-vaccine and radiation-precaution advice.

modes.label: Infection after risk/transmission
modes.description: The word infection ends a phrase about risk or secondary transmission from live vaccines.
modes.example: The use of live attenuated vaccines may carry the risk of<< infection>>. Prevention or Management: Live attenuated
